title: Things to Do (for the weekend of September 19th)
description:
Looking for something to do in Los Angeles? From Oktoberfest Zoo fun and legendary jazz to Japanese library tours and puppet magic, here’s what’s happening near you.

🦁 ZOOTOBERFEST
Saturday, September 19 & Sunday, September 20 | 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Make the L.A. Zoo your festive fall destination at "Zoo-toberfest." Enjoy an Oktoberfest-themed weekend filled with German-inspired food, live Oktoberfest bands, specialty beers, lawn games, photo-ops, and keeper talks.
🌐 LAZoo.org

🎷 CENTRAL AVE JAZZ FESTIVAL
Saturday, September 19
Snap to the Central Avenue Jazz Festival, now celebrating its 31st year! Experience four pavilions, three stages of live music, delicious food, and a vibrant marketplace along Central Avenue between MLK Boulevard and Vernon.
🌐 CentralAveJazzFestival.com

📚 CENTRAL LIBRARY TOUR IN JAPANESE
Saturday, September 19 | 1:30 PM
Say "Konnichiwa" as the Los Angeles Public Library offers a special docent tour of the Central Library in Japanese. Explore the art and architecture of this iconic L.A. landmark as part of its Centennial Celebrations.
🌐 LAPL.org

🎭 BOB BAKER DAY
Sunday, September 20 | 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Celebrate Bob Baker Day as the Marionette Theater's free annual festival returns! Head to L.A. State Historic Park for a day filled with puppet shows, activities, and fun character marionettes.
🌐 BobBakerDay.com
